## Fixed cost per kernel, measured directly (bench/fixed_cost.py)

Sweep `20261120-121628_fixed_cost`: each shape's weight copied until the copies exceed 2.0 GiB (≫ L2), one GEMV per copy, captured in one CUDA graph; µs per kernel = replay time ÷ kernels (median of replays).
